title: What a 70 percent chance of rain really means
examples: What does 70 percent chance of rain mean?
Does 70 percent mean it rains 70 percent of the day?
Should I take an umbrella at 30 percent?

explain.say: The weather app says: 70 percent chance of rain. Does that mean it will rain for 70 percent of the day? Or on 70 percent of your town? Neither! Look at the bar on the board. It's split into 10 equal parts, and 7 are coloured in.

draw.text: What a 70 percent chance of rain really means

explain.say: 70 percent means 70 out of 100, which is the same as 7 out of 10. Imagine 10 days with weather just like tomorrow's. On about 7 of them it would rain where you are, and on about 3 it would stay dry. Can you count the parts that aren't coloured?

Yes, 3! So 70 percent doesn't promise rain. Rain is likely, but there's still a 3 in 10 chance you stay dry. And it doesn't tell you how much rain, or for how long, only how likely it is that some falls.

Look at the three groups. With a low chance, leave the umbrella. In the middle, pack a small one just in case. At 70 percent or more, take an umbrella or raincoat. Which group would you pack for tomorrow?

Great job! Look: the top bar shows 70 percent, the bottom bar 30 percent. Even 30 percent means rain on about 3 days out of 10 like that, so it does happen! Challenge: for one week, write down the rain chance and whether it rained. Were the forecasts right?

faq.q: What does a 70 percent chance of rain mean?
faq.a: It means that on about 7 out of 10 days with weather like this, some rain falls where you are. It doesn't mean rain for 70 percent of the day.
asks: What does chance of rain mean?

faq.q: Does 70 percent mean it will rain on 70 percent of the area?
faq.a: No. The percentage is the chance that rain falls at any one place in the forecast area during that time.
asks: Does chance of rain mean how much of the town gets wet?

faq.q: Does a high chance of rain mean heavy rain?
faq.a: No. The chance tells you how likely rain is, not how much. A 90 percent chance could be light drizzle.
asks: Does 100 percent chance mean lots of rain?

faq.q: How do forecasters work out the chance of rain?
faq.a: They run their computer forecast many times with small changes. If 7 out of 10 runs show rain at your place, that suggests about a 70 percent chance.
asks: Where does the rain percentage come from?

faq.q: Should I take an umbrella at 30 percent?
faq.a: Rain is less likely than not, but it happens on about 3 days out of 10 like that. If getting wet would be a problem, a small umbrella is handy.
asks: Is 30 percent chance of rain a lot?

facts: A 70% chance of rain means rain is expected at a given place on about 7 of 10 occasions with similar weather.
The chance of rain does not tell you how heavy or how long the rain will be.
